rawFindings.title: Source map usage should require a line number
rawFindings.explanation: The condition checking if source maps should be used was changed from requiring both a file with a source map and a line number to just requiring a file with a source map. This will cause the code to attempt to use source maps even when no line number is provided, potentially leading to errors or incorrect results.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check for the presence of a line number when using source maps by changing the condition back to if (file && file.sourceMap && line).
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: An error message string without a line number causes the function to attempt source map resolution, leading to exceptions or incorrect error formatting.
